title: EventSeverityType
description: Filter by event severity, if exists. Currently for failed events only. See [Tracking Failures](https://documentation.mailgun.com/docs/mailgun/user-manual/tracking-messages/#tracking-failures)

x-enumDescriptions.temporary: Mailgun could not deliver the email to the recipient email server, but will retry
x-enumDescriptions.permanent: Mailgun could not deliver the email to the recipient email server, and will drop the message without retrying sending.
